text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I asked Duramente if she was able to 
spend her day off relaxing—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I got a message from my older sisters and 
gave them an update on how I've been 
doing.
choice_data_list:
What did you talk about with your big 
sister?

What did you talk about with your big 
sister?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It was mainly about racing. My sister 
asked me questions quite often.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Are your uphill times improving? What's 
your current muscle mass? Be careful not 
to overtrain. ...Just our usual 
conversation like always.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Having a long chat with my sisters was a 
great way to refresh myself.
